S22.01.note: The chip text is the site name only; it is not a fixed label in the code.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Turn on web search in the chat input, then ask a current-events question such as "What is the latest news on <topic>?".
Wait for the answer to finish streaming.
Look for small rounded chips with a site name placed after sentences; a "+N" on a chip means more sources.
Click a chip and confirm it opens the source page in a new tab.
S22.01.where: Chat with web search on > ask a question about a current topic > after the answer sentences, click the small rounded chip that shows a site name

S22.02.note: The card is a Radix tooltip. On touch, a tap may open the link before the card appears; the code does not special-case this.
steps: Get an answer that shows citation chips, as in S22.01.
Move the pointer over one chip and wait for the card to appear.
Check the card shows the source title, the site name, the date if known, and a snippet if known.
Move the pointer away and confirm the card closes.
S22.02.where: Chat with web search on > hover (or tap) a citation chip from S22.01

steps: Ask a web-search question and wait for the answer.
Look for the "Sources" button under the answer; it shows a count when there are more than 3 sources.
Click "Sources" to open the side panel on its Sources tab.
Check each row shows a title, site, link and optional snippet, and click one to open it.
If there are no sources, check the panel shows "No sources yet".
S22.03.where: Chat with web search on > under the answer click the "Sources" button

S22.05.needs: an image-search provider and key (not set up)
S22.05.note: The carousel component exists (Previous and Next controls in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/AnswerGallery.tsx), but only the model writes it, and apps/web/lib/web-search/web-search-providers.json lists only perplexity-search, so no image provider is wired. Searched for carousel and image search.

S22.08.note: The quoted code line moved; the chart renders through ChartArtifact.tsx and ChartCanvas.tsx.
steps: Ask the assistant for a chart with a few rows of numbers.
When the chart card appears in the answer, click "Open artifact".
In the panel, hover over bars or points and check a value appears.
Check the legend shows when there is more than one series.
Click the chart's download button and check a PNG file is saved.
S22.08.where: Chat > ask for a chart (for example "Make a bar chart of ...") > click "Open artifact" on the chart card

S22.09.note: The chart plots only the first rows (CHART_ROW_CAP); the note says the full data is in the JSON download.
steps: Open a chart as in S22.08.
Under the chart, click "View chart data" to expand a table of the values.
Check the table has the same values as the chart.
Click the panel's "Download" button and check the data can be saved.
Check a note appears if the chart has more rows than it plots.
S22.09.where: Chat > open a chart artifact ("Open artifact") > under the chart click "View chart data"

S22.10.needs: a web search or place tool that returns coordinates
S22.10.note: The map appears only when the model writes a map block. The tile provider needs AGI_MAP_TILE_URL_TEMPLATE set, and the owner's setup is unfinished, so a live check is needed.
steps: Ask for several real places, for example "Show me 3 coffee shops in <city> on a map".
Look for a card titled "Map" under the answer.
Check markers appear and the map shows the basemap credit line.
Try moving and zooming the map, if it is interactive.
S22.10.where: Chat > ask for several places to be shown on a map > a card titled "Map" appears in the answer

S22.11.needs: a Google Places key with billing (GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY), not set up
S22.11.note: A place search tool exists (label "Place search" in apps/web/lib/tool-copy.ts) and is not offered without the key. I searched for PlaceCard, place card and search_places and found no card component that renders name, rating, address, hours and links.

S22.17.note: The button shows only when the answer is typed as a comparison.
steps: Ask the assistant to compare two or three products.
Look for the "View as comparison" button under the answer.
Click it and check the side-by-side comparison card appears.
Check each item shows "Pros" and "Cons" where given, and a "Winner" mark where one is set.
Click "Hide comparison view" to return to the text.
S22.17.where: Chat > ask to compare products (for example "Compare X and Y") > click "View as comparison" under the answer

S22.25.note: Expected lists copy, send and open actions, but EmailArtifact.tsx has only the copy action. Searched for Send, Open and mailto in that file.
steps: Ask the assistant to draft an email with a recipient and a subject.
Click "Open artifact" on the card.
Check the widget shows To, Subject and the body.
Click "Copy email as text" and paste it somewhere to check the text.
Look for a send or open action; none was found in the code.
S22.25.where: Chat > ask for an email draft (for example "Draft an email to ...") > click "Open artifact" on the draft card

labels.text: This tool requires approval before execution.

S22.28.needs: a setting that makes the assistant ask before a tool runs
S22.28.note: The Tool approvals panel is at apps/web/features/settings/components/ToolApprovalDefaultsPanel.tsx, but it is not mounted in any page I found, so the settings path is unknown.
steps: Set Tool Approvals to ask before each action, if you can find the setting; the settings panel was not found mounted in the app.
Ask the assistant to do an action that needs a tool, such as a file change or a web fetch.
When the card appears, read "This tool requires approval before execution." and the buttons below it.
Click "Deny" and check the action stops; run again and click "Allow" to check it continues.
S22.28.where: Chat > ask for an action that needs approval (Tool Approvals set to ask before running) > the approval card under the tool step

S22.29.note: The assistant decides when to ask; the tester cannot open the form directly.
steps: Ask a vague request so the assistant needs details, for example "Plan a trip for me".
Look for an inline form with questions and options.
Pick options or type in "Other answer for" when offered.
Click "Send answers" and check the form shows "Sending" and then the reply continues.
Check a skipped question shows "Skipped".
S22.29.where: Chat > the assistant asks questions in an inline form > type or pick answers > click "Send answers"

S22.30.note: The table is ordinary Markdown from the answer; no title or control is added by the app.
steps: Ask for a comparison of three options in a table.
Check the answer shows a table with a header row and aligned columns.
Resize the window narrow and check the table scrolls sideways instead of breaking the page.
S22.30.where: Chat > ask for a comparison table (for example "Make a table comparing X, Y and Z")

S22.31.note: Mind maps are drawn as Mermaid diagrams; the model chooses the diagram type.
steps: Ask for a mind map of a topic.
Check a drawn diagram appears under the answer.
Click "Show source" to see the diagram code, then "Hide source" to return.
Click "Expand diagram" to open it full size, then close it with the close button.
S22.31.where: Chat > ask for a mind map (for example "Make a mind map of ...") > the diagram card under the answer

S22.32.note: Flowcharts are drawn as Mermaid diagrams; the model chooses the diagram type.
steps: Ask for a flowchart of a process.
Check a drawn flowchart appears under the answer with boxes and arrows.
Click "Show source" and then "Hide source".
Click "Expand diagram" and check it opens larger.
S22.32.where: Chat > ask for a flowchart (for example "Draw a flowchart of ...") > the diagram card under the answer

S22.33.note: A separate timeline answer block also exists in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/AnswerSurface.tsx; the tester may see either.
steps: Ask for a timeline of events in order.
Check a drawn timeline appears under the answer.
Click "Show source" and then "Hide source".
Click "Expand diagram" and check it opens larger.
S22.33.where: Chat > ask for a timeline (for example "Make a timeline of ...") > the diagram card under the answer

steps: Ask for a small interactive page or React component, such as a counter or a slider.
Click "Open artifact" on the card.
In the panel, click "Preview" and try the controls in the demo.
Click "Fullscreen" and check the demo fills the screen, then return.
Click "Source" to see the code.
S22.36.where: Chat > ask for an interactive demo (for example "Build a small interactive ...") > click "Open artifact" on the card

S22.37.needs: a connected third-party app that returns an interactive view
S22.37.note: The embedded panel is an iframe titled "<tool name> interactive result" in apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/cards/McpAppCard.tsx. I did not find the menu path that connects a third-party app, so no visible path was found.

steps: Ask the assistant to build a small website or app.
Click "Open artifact" on the card.
Check the live preview loads in the panel.
Click "Fullscreen" and check the preview expands; click it again to return.
Open the more menu and click "Open in new tab" to check the preview opens in a new tab.
S22.38.where: Chat > ask for a small app or website (for example "Build a simple website for ...") > click "Open artifact" on the card
